title: 4-Stage Candidate Block Validation for Textual Backprop Loops

claims.assertion: Autonomous agent self-repair and prompt optimization must pass through a strict 4-stage candidate block validation gate (baseline → AST syntax → sandbox execution → invariant contract) with momentum-smoothed gradient updates to eliminate catastrophic prompt regression.

context: Unconstrained agent self-modification creates destructive feedback loops and syntax regressions. Multi-stage gating ensures only Pareto-optimal prompt revisions are committed.
